<infobox theme="Media">
	<image source="image"></image>
    <title source="title"></title>
    <group collapse="open">
    	<header>Production information</header>
        <data source="series"><label>Series</label></data>
        <data source="season"><label>Season</label></data>
        <data source="episode"><label>Episode</label></data>
        <data source="production"><label>Production No.</label></data>
        <data source="screener"><label>Early screening</label></data>
        <data source="airdate"><label>Air date</label><format><!--
        -->{{#ifeq:{{lc:{{{airdate|}}}}}|none||{{#ifeq:{{lc:{{{airdate|}}}}}|future||{{#ifeq:{{lc:{{{airdate|}}}}}|canceled||{{#ifeq:{{lc:{{{airdate|}}}}}|cancelled||{{{airdate}}}}}}}}}}}<!--
        --></format></data>
        <data source="intl release"><label>International release</label></data>
        <data source="runtime"><label>Run time</label></data>
    </group>
    <group collapse="open">
    	<header>Attribution information</header>
        <data source="director"><label>Director(s)</label></data>
        <data source="writer"><label>Writer(s)</label></data>
        <data source="production company"><label>Production company</label></data>
        <data source="guests"><label>Guest star(s)</label></data>	      
    </group>
    <group collapse="open">
    	<header>Episode chronology</header>
        <data source="timeline"><label>Timeline</label></data>
        <data source="canon_timeline"><label>Timeline&#32;<small>&#32;([[Canon]])</small></label></data>
        <data source="legends_timeline"><label>Timeline&#32;<small>&#32;([[Star Wars Legends|Legends]])</small></label></data>
        <data source="prev"><label>Prior episode</label></data>
        <data source="next"><label>Next episode</label></data>			
    </group>
	<navigation><small>{{PlainLink|//starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Template:TelevisionEpisode|name=<nowiki>[</nowiki>Source<nowiki>]</nowiki>}}</small></navigation>
</infobox>{{PreloadCat}}<!-- TEMPLATE ENDS HERE.

-->{{#invoke:MediaDateCheck|main|no_year_check={{{no_year_check|}}}|template_name=TelevisionEpisode}}<includeonly>{{AppMediaCat|not_appearance={{{not_appearance|}}}}}</includeonly><noinclude>[[Category:Television and video infoboxes]]{{clear}}
